name: Female Ministers
overview: Scripture affirms that both male and female were created in the image of God, establishing equal value before Him (Genesis 1:27). Women served God in significant ministerial roles, such as Miriam and Deborah, who were recognized as prophetesses and leaders in Israel (Exodus 15:20; Judges 4:4). Anna, also a prophetess, exemplifies faithful service in later years (Luke 2:36). While the New Testament records Jesus’ ministry accompanied by women, the sample verses focus on their supportive roles rather than formal apostolic leadership (Luke 8:1). Proverbs 31 highlights the commendation of a woman’s works, indicating that female service and ministry are honored when aligned with God’s purposes (Proverbs 31:31).
